events.text: Three masters in Orthodox robes block the road. "The Alliance has a list," says the eldest. "Your name is near the top."

ok.log: Three masters go home on stretchers. The list gets a little longer.

fail.log: They are good. You get away, and they will be back.

ok.log: By the end of the evening they are not sure you are as bad as the list says. Neither are you.

fail.log: The talking fails. So does a good part of your ribcage.

events.text: A woman in black and red sits down at your table uninvited. "The Heavenly Demon has heard of you. He likes what he hears. There is a seat for you in the Hundred Thousand Mountains."

effects.log: You leave with her before the tea is cold. The murim will hear about this by morning.
"A pity," she says, and pays for your tea. You notice she never touched hers.

events.text: The Martial Alliance invites you to its annual council, not as a guest but with a seat at the table.

effects.log: Nine sect leaders stand when you enter. You try very hard to look like this is normal.

choices.text: Send a gift and your regrets

effects.log: A wanderer's heart does not sit well at councils. They respect you more for it.
